votes.motion: Grant an extension of time to make the required repairs at 605 Mulpus Road until the tenant has vacated.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by shea, the board voted to grant an extension on the time to repair until the tenant has vacated.

votes.motion: Affirm the original 2003 well permit, including its variances, for 11 Spring Street.
votes.quote: on motion by passios and second by jewell, variances granted. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances requested for 11 Rangeley Road.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by shea, the variances were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Appoint George Emond as Chairman, Perry Jewell as Vice-Chairman and David Shea as Secretary of the Board.
votes.quote: the board of health voted unanimously to appoint george emond as chairman, perry jewell as vice-chairman and david shea as secretary of the board.

votes.motion: Approve the annual request for use of portable facilities at Shady Point Campground.
votes.quote: the board reviewed and unanimously approved the annual request for the use of portable facilities at shady point campground.

decisions.decision: Time was requested at the next Board of Health meeting, so the 424 Page Street discussion is continued to the next meeting.
decisions.quote: time was requested at the next board of health meeting to continue the discussion.

decisions.decision: Board will work with the owner to install an adequate septic system at 424 Page Street, provided the conditions are met.
decisions.quote: provided that these conditions are met, the board stated that they would be willing to work with the owner to install an adequate system.

decisions.decision: Before the board can consider a variance for 424 Page Street, the prospective buyer must provide water usage data from similar establishments and a business plan and use of the property.
decisions.quote: further, that mr. karapatsas has to provide the board with a business plan and use of the property before they can entertain a variance.

decisions.decision: Board position that the 424 Page Street work cannot be treated as a repair because of the change of use.
decisions.quote: chairman emond stated that it could not be viewed as a repair because of the change of use and that the current system does not fully comply with current title v requirements.
